claim.point: The export ran out of memory and was killed because the parquet-writer 3.0 upgrade on 30 October made its default row groups much larger.
claim.detail: The default went from 10,000 to 1,000,000 rows, about 100 times more rows held in memory per batch; the job hit the 2 GiB container limit. The export config never set the value.

ask.point: Approve deploying the drafted fix, which sets the row group size back to 10,000, during the change freeze.
ask.detail: The fix is one line on branch fix/export-row-groups; the freeze runs until 7 November and deploying needs the asker's sign-off.

stakes.point: Until the fix is deployed the export fails every night and the partner, Harbor Analytics, misses that day's data.
stakes.detail: The partner's monthly reconciliation on Friday 6 November would run on incomplete data.
